options.name: auth
options.description: Authentication parameters. Can define each of them with ENV as well.

options.name: cluster_role
options.description: Name of the cluster role. Note that the resulting role binding grants the cluster role to the provided users and groups in the context of I(auth.namespace) only. This parameter is mutually exclusive with I(role).

options.name: groups
options.description: List of groups to bind to the role or cluster role. Note that at least one of I(users) and I(groups) must be specified when creating a role binding.

options.name: name
options.description: The Sensu resource's name. This name (in combination with the namespace where applicable) uniquely identifies the resource that Ansible operates on. If the resource with selected name already exists, Ansible module will update it to match the specification in the task. Consult the I(name) metadata attribute specification in the upstream docs on U(https://docs.sensu.io/sensu-go/latest/reference/) for more details about valid names and other restrictions.

options.name: namespace
options.description: RBAC namespace to operate in. If this is not set the value of the SENSU_NAMESPACE environment variable will be used.

options.name: role
options.description: Name of the role. This parameter is mutually exclusive with I(cluster_role).

options.name: state
options.description: Target state of the Sensu object.

options.name: users
options.description: List of users to bind to the role or cluster role. Note that at least one of I(users) and I(groups) must be specified when creating a role binding.
